description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Mental Mutation

Your mind becomes attuned to dark powers and you gain an instinctual understanding of a Lore. Dhar or Chaos energy flicker around you in an alarming fashion. Consult the table below to see which Lore you gain. If you have a patron of Chaos then you automatically gain their Lore. You cannot gain this mutation if Khorne is your patron. You do not gain Corruption if you level up the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.hiU7vhBOVpVI8c7C]{Chaos Magic} Talent through this mutation. Gaining this mutation several times will give you additional levels in the same Lore.
